narr: A surface low over southeastern Colorado with boundaries extending south and northeast across northwestern counties of the CWA helped initiate severe thunderstorms and eventually heavy rainfall. Boundary layer moisture was rather high across the area. Strong shear and good instability was mainly west of the Hwy 83 corridor with the bulk of reports in this area. Later in the evening the main threat was heavy rainfall with 2-4 inches reported. There were several reports of tornadoes but a thorough investigation, including reviewing video, confirmed numerous gustnadoes and an extensive amount of outflow scud clouds.
ev: Over 5 inches of rainfall was observed.
lsr: SOCIAL MEDIA REPORT OF 5 PLUS INCHES OF RAIN.
